class.name: vizanti_nav2/Navigation 2
class.description: The Nav2 panel: startup / pause / reset of the Nav2 lifecycle nodes, NavigateToPose, waypoint following and NavigateThroughPoses, as in RViz.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Nav2 Goal
class.description: Set a Nav2 goal; in the Navigation 2 panel's waypoint mode, add a waypoint.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Selector
class.description: Choose the controller, planner, goal checker, smoother, progress checker and path handler Nav2 uses.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Docking
class.description: Dock and undock the robot with Nav2's docking server, by dock id or by dock pose and type.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Costmap Cost
class.description: Click a point to read its cost in Nav2's local and global costmaps.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/ParticleCloud
class.description: nav2_msgs/ParticleCloud (AMCL's particles) as flat arrows, 3D arrows or axes, each as long as its weight.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Route Tool
class.description: Build and edit a Nav2 route graph: add, move and remove nodes and edges, load and save nav2_route GeoJSON.

class.name: vizanti_nav2/Nav2 Tools
class.description: Clear the costmaps, run a recovery behaviour (spin, back up, drive on heading, wait, assisted teleop), and see the state of every Nav2 lifecycle node. Not in RViz.
